author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260513T014512Z-2345176
text:
Partial progress 2026-05-12: 5 of 8 candidate RFC-conformance lints shipped in pkix-lint 0.7.0 (commit ed5a1f72). Remaining 3 filed as PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1.

Shipped:
- `rfc5280::Rfc5280BasicConstraintsCaLeafLint` — RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 (BC.cA=FALSE for leaves)
- `rfc5280::Rfc5280EkuServerAuthLint` — RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12 (id-kp-serverAuth required)
- `rfc6125::Rfc6125TlsServerSanLint` — RFC 6125 §6.4.1 (SAN dNSName or iPAddress)
- `rfc8398::Rfc8398SmimeSanLint` — RFC 8398 §3 + RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 (SAN rfc822Name or SmtpUTF8Mailbox)
- `rfc8551::Rfc8551EkuEmailProtectionLint` — RFC 8551 §3.3 + RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12 (id-kp-emailProtection required)

Three new public modules: rfc6125, rfc8398, rfc8551. pkix-lint 0.6.0 → 0.7.0 (additive). 13 new tests, all pass. cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings clean on pkix-lint. Workspace builds and tests clean (pre-existing pkix-path-builder clippy lint at lib.rs:1043 is unrelated and out of scope).

Deferred (filed as PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1):
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6 SAN-when-subject-empty (needs RDN-emptiness logic + new fixture)
- RFC 5280 §4.1 signatureAlgorithm match (needs AlgorithmIdentifier equality + custom DER fixture)
- RFC 8398 §3 rfc822Name/SmtpUTF8Mailbox pair equivalence (needs idna canonicalization + new fixture)

This bead stays OPEN pending PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1 closure (its 8-candidate strict acceptance bar is not yet met).

Releasing claim. The path forward is: close PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1 when its 3 lints land, then auto-close this bead.
